sv.title: Busters ovanliga hockeyresa: ”Fick straff när man inte gjorde läxorna”
sv.summary: Buster Larsson har upplevt den våldsamma hockeyn i de amerikanska sydstaterna och stortrivs nu i tyska tredjeligan. På köpet har Malmökillen skaffat sig en universitetsutbildning. – När jag bodde i Sverige hade jag inte skolan på min radar alls, säger den 28-årige forwarden.

en.title: Buster's unusual hockey journey: "I got punished when I didn't do my homework"
en.summary: Buster Larsson has experienced the violent hockey of the American southern states and is thriving in the German third tier. On top of that, the Malmö lad has acquired a university degree. "When I lived in Sweden I didn't have school on my radar at all," says the 28-year-old forward.
